motivation.zh: 把一维素数分布和双点算术分开，用中心窗内一段连续子区间给原目标提供下界。
motivation.en: Separate one-dimensional prime distribution from two-point arithmetic on a subinterval of the central window.

tasks.statement: ∀ (H : ℕ) (a b : Fin H → ℝ), (∑ s, ∑ t, (a s-a t)*(b s-b t)) = 2*((H:ℝ)*(∑ s, a s*b s)-(∑ s, a s)*(∑ t, b t))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0102 · 单块上的带符号差分恒等式
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0102 · Signed mixed differences on one cell

brief.zh: 将已有平方差恒等式极化，或展开双和。计入两份交叉项。
brief.en: Polarize the squared-distance identity or expand the double sum. Count both cross terms.

tasks.statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); ∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0103 · 每个中心短区间的素数权至少为块长的一半
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0103 · Prime weight exceeds half a block length at every central start

brief.zh: 块长约为 n 的四分之三次方。以一致短区间素数定理为入口，核对半开区间的端点、对数权及对全部 x 有效的共同阈值。
brief.en: Apply a uniform short-interval prime theorem at length of order n to the power 3/4. Transfer to the half-open interval and prime log weight with one threshold for all starts.

tasks.statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0104 · 由单块质量把组内差分嵌入中心窗
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0104 · Embed within-cell differences into the central window

brief.zh: 把 [n/2,5n/8) 分为 B 个长度 H 的块，BH=n/8。反射块起点为 n−(n/2+jH+H−1)。块总权乘积除以 H 至少为 H/4；块外项非负。
brief.en: Partition [n/2,5n/8) into B cells of H points, with BH=n/8. Reverse each reflected cell starting at n−(n/2+jH+H−1). Each product of block sums divided by H is at least H/4. All omitted terms are nonnegative.

tasks.statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); -(n:ℝ)/64 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0105 · 反射块内差分的逐尺度单侧下界（开放）
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0105 · One-sided cancellation of reflected within-cell differences (open)

brief.zh: 按位移 t−s 重排，比较两侧素数权增量同号与异号的贡献。保留总和的符号和分母 2H；需要对每个充分大的 k 成立。
brief.en: Group by the lag t−s and compare aligned and opposed prime-weight increments. Keep the signed sum and denominator 2H. The bound must hold at every sufficiently large k.

tasks.statement: (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); ∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); -(n:ℝ)/64 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ)))) → (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, let n : ℕ := 2^k; c*(n : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0106 · 以常数 1/64 回到冻结的二次幂父题
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0106 · Recover the frozen dyadic target with constant 1/64

brief.zh: 引入三个前提，取两个阈值与 12 的最大值。在同一 k 代入有限比较，得到 n/32−n/64=n/64。
brief.en: Introduce the three hypotheses, take the maximum of 12 and the two eventual thresholds, then combine the inequalities at the same k to obtain n/64.

explanation.zh: 同一 k 上，块基线和组内差分预算合出 n/64。
explanation.en: At the same k the block baseline and signed budget yield n/64.

route_note.zh: 二次幂中心窗可分块：先估计单侧短区间的素数权，再研究反射块中增量的符号。逐尺度抵消仍待证明。
route_note.en: On dyadic targets, estimate prime weight in single intervals and then study the signs of reflected within-cell increments. Pointwise cancellation remains open.
